name: Mitten Extracts | 3g Max Pro Disposable | Ice Berry Gelato
description:
Cool, creamy, and bursting with berry flavor, Ice Berry Gelato blends sweet mixed berries with a refreshing icy finish. Smooth and flavorful from start to finish, this Max Pro disposable delivers a perfectly balanced experience that’s both crisp and satisfying.

Packed with 3G of Liquid Diamonds + Live Resin terpenes for a smooth, powerful experience that lasts. Fine-tune every hit with Flavor, Balance, or Clouds mode.
